mentions.name: HellOMDX
mentions.description: This app is a Markdown file editor aimed at average users, letting them format documents by clicking buttons like MS Word instead of memorizing syntax. Built with Tauri, it has a small installer and near-instant startup on all three desktop OSes. It requires no accounts, no telemetry, and no MDX server; sync goes through whatever cloud folder the user already has (iCloud, Drive, Dropbox, or a plain directory). Tab-to-accept ghost-writing is bring-your-own-key. Documents export to PDF, HTML, and DOCX, with tables, math, diagrams, and code blocks all accessible behind toolbar buttons.
mentions.problem: Markdown editing typically requires memorizing syntax, which is a barrier for average users who want to format documents with buttons as in MS Word.
mentions.audience: Average users who want to edit Markdown files without learning syntax
